doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Jimmy Noon, Nene Quacku and the barbers
title: Jimmy Noon's teacher and the sale of the Stanton plantation
summary: Russell asks again who taught Jimmy Noon. Martin does not know, and repeats that the family moved when the Stanton plantation was sold, where Martin says he was born.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Oh, Wednesday. Wednesday. Wednesday. This is Monday, isn't it? Yeah, Wednesday. Forget what day it is. Um, I was gonna ask a little bit more while I think of it about Jimmy Noon, if, uh, uh, do you know who his teacher was, or did he have a teacher at first, anybody you knew?
No, teacher. He didn't teach. Oh. Never did know his teacher.
And then he moved over on this side, though, pretty soon.

That's right, when he sold Stanton Plantation out. Yeah. Old man Ruppley. Sold, uh, I mean, this, uh, Stanton sold plantation to Ruppley. And then, they moved. Yeah, Noon had been living right on the plantation then. Yeah, I was born there. Born there.
